subject: CPPO reseller readiness kickoff and SKU/billing alignment
messages:
From: Oliver King <oliver@cloudresell.co>

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO reseller readiness checklist + proposed kick-off

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the intro call last week — excited to get the private offer for CloudResell Co moving. Attached is a draft readiness checklist (CPPO_Readiness_Checklist.xlsx) our ops team uses for marketplace launches. We want to confirm a few items before we lock the go-live window:

- SKU mapping: canonical SKUs vs marketplace SKUs (we've started a CSV)
- Billing split & invoice routing for multi-entity customers
- Evidence packaging (POC/demo quotas, entitlements)
- DocuSign/contract flow for reseller margin and Special Pricing

Can we schedule a 45-minute ops kickoff this week to align on owners? Our procurement lead (procurement@cloudresell.co) and legal (sarah.legal@cloudresell.co) should join for the contract path.

Proposed times (PDT): Thu 9/16 10:00 or Fri 9/17 09:00. Which works?

Thanks,
Oliver
Partner Success Manager
CloudResell Co
[attachment: CPPO_Readiness_Checklist.xlsx (xls)]

Hi Oliver — thanks for sending this over and for the suggested times. Thursday 9/16 10:00 PDT works for our team. I'll book the meeting and include a short agenda.

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & desired go-live window
2) SKU mapping and who will own the canonical -> marketplace SKU table
3) Billing/invoice split approach and required finance evidence
4) Legal flow: CPPO margin, reseller contract vs Redwood Master
5) Action items and owners + DocuSign timeline

Ben, Vanessa — can you both bring the latest SKU mapping and a note on entitlements (who provisions the subscription vs who invoices)? Aditya, please add recommended cadence for pre-launch testing on Dedicated vs Hosted SKUs.

Oliver — when you loop procurement/legal please ask them to attach any internal PO templates or specific DocuSign fields they need.

I'll send a calendar invite for Thu 9/16 10:00 PDT.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Hannah / Oliver — quick notes ahead of the kickoff:

- Attached SKU_Mapping_v1.csv is our working table. Columns: Redwood_SKU, Marketplace_SKU, Entitlement_Type, Billing_Entity. I flagged a few SKUs that require entitlements on Redwood Dedicated vs Hosted.
- Billing: CloudResell requested invoice-to routing to their EU entity in one of the accounts we scoped — we'll need to confirm tax/VAT handling.
- Entitlements: For trial/demo quotas we recommend using a temporary entitlement token that expires at go-live. Post-go-live, we hand provisioning to reseller via reseller APIs.
- Margin/Discounts: If reseller needs a margin higher than our standard CPPO, legal will need to approve a Special Pricing Appendix.

I'll have a short slideshow for the call covering the SKU edge cases.

-ben
Ben Carter
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
